narr: Numerous showers and thunderstorms developing during the morning of the 27th across eastern Tennessee, lasting into the early afternoon hours. The slow moving nature of these storms produced some rainfall totals in the 3 to 5 inch range for portions of Hawkins and Sevier counties, leading to some reports of flooding there.
ev: Social media video showed a small stream out of its banks and flooding over driveways on Amis Chapel Road. Time of video unknown.
